subject: Re: Renewal conversation — continuity & commitment proposal
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finorb.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Concern ahead of renewal — repeated latency spikes & clarification needed

Mateo, Camila —

Thanks for the quick responses over the weekend. We saw two separate incidents on Nov 8 and Nov 9 where request latency spiked and roughly 3% of inference calls returned 5xx errors for short windows (about 7–12 minutes each). These events are putting the renewal discussion on hold internally — our infra team needs clearer uptime and latency commitments before we can sign a multi-quarter deal.

Specifically, can Redwood propose a concrete upgrade path (SLA language + operational changes) that addresses:
- guaranteed monthly uptime target,
- p95 latency objective for our typical request mix (short prompts, embeddings), and
- a clear credit/remedy schedule for misses

We'd also like to understand short-term mitigations you can implement while we evaluate a longer term plan. Can we get a written proposal today and book a 30–45 minute call tomorrow?

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
VP Engineering, FinOrb Financial
[Attachment: incident_summary_excerpt.txt (plain text) — included in-line]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finorb.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Concern ahead of renewal — repeated latency spikes & clarification needed

Alex —

I'm very sorry for the disruption you saw. I appreciate the specificity — that helps. Short answer: yes, we can propose an accelerated upgrade path and immediate mitigations.

Immediate actions (today):
- I asked infra to pin a capacity reserve for your production pool to avoid noisy-neighbor effects.
- We pulled a telemetry snippet (attached) showing the CPU/GPU utilization during the windows; initial look points at transient autoscaler overshoot + network congestion in the eu-west-1 peering (we'll confirm).

Proposal: I'd like to propose a short Dedicated pilot that buys you isolated capacity and a formal SLA amendment committing to a higher uptime and a p95 latency objective. Camila (serving runtime) and Rishi (commercial/contracts) are looped in to scope feasibility and draft the amendment.

Can we take a 30-min call tomorrow at 10:00am PT to walk through options? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a preliminary draft (for your legal/ops to review).

Thanks again — I want to make sure we get you a solution that removes these blockers for renewal.

— Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: telemetry_snippet.csv (CSV)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Concern ahead of renewal — FinOrb needs SLA + pilot

Folks — forwarding FinOrb's note. TL;DR: two short latency/5xx windows, customer is pausing renewal until we put a stronger uptime/latency commitment and remedy in place.

Ask: please confirm realistic SLOs we can offer (monthly uptime, p95 latency), a short mitigation roadmap (hotfix/capacity/fallbacks), and an initial commercial outline and cost delta for a 3-month Dedicated pilot.

Quick thoughts from me: offer a three-month dedicated pilot (isolated pool) + an SLA amendment (target 99.95% monthly uptime and p95 latency <120ms for their short-prompt profile). If engineering can sign off, we offer:
- guaranteed capacity reservation,
- telemetry retention + per-route tracing,
- credit structure for misses (sliding scale),
- expedited playbook and runbook access for their SREs.

Please reply with the wording you want in the draft and any hard no's on numbers.

— Mateo

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Concern ahead of renewal — FinOrb needs SLA + pilot

Mateo / Rishi —

Thanks for the context and the telemetry. High-level: the proposal below is technically feasible with a short runway and clear guardrails. Details: 

Operational proposal (technical):
- Short-term (within 48hrs): pin a 20% capacity buffer on the FinOrb production pool and enable aggressive prefix caching for hot routes. That should eliminate the transient 5xx cluster we saw.
- Pilot (3 months): Dedicated GPU pool (8x A100 equivalent baseline), pinned autoscaler rules, reserved networking lanes for their region.
- SLOs we can realistically commit to for the pilot: 99.95% monthly availability; p95 latency <120ms for standard generation calls (<=512 tokens), with enterprise tracing and 30-day telemetry retention.

Cost and constraints:
- Incremental cost estimate for the dedicated pilot: ~$65k/month (includes reserved capacity + enhanced observability + priority support). I'll refine with infra cost accounting if Finance wants an exact number.
- We will require a 30-day notice for scaling down from the reserved baseline.

Attachments: I attached a draft SLA amendment we can use as a starting point (sla_amendment_draft.pdf). The draft includes the above SLOs and a placeholder credit table.

If you want, I can join the call with Alex to walk through the technical tradeoffs.

— Camila
Director, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sla_amendment_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finorb.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — continuity & commitment proposal

Alex / team —

Appreciate the patience here. Commercial/contract notes:
- Credit schedule suggestion (tiered monthly):
  * <99.5% = 10% credit,
  * 99.5%–99.8% = 5% credit,
  * >=99.95% = no credit (SLA met)
- Credits apply to the monthly invoice and are capped at 30% per month.
- We'll include an escalation clause that allows temporary capacity boosts (at a pre-agreed hourly rate) if an incident looks like it will exceed the credit threshold.

Next steps:
1) If the customer agrees in principle, I'll circulate a redline version of the amendment for their counsel.
2) We can push a DocuSign envelope once legal approves.

I've attached my redlines for internal review (amendment_redline.docx). I also put a placeholder DocuSign link in the metadata.

— Rishi
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: amendment_redline.docx (DOCX)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finorb.com>, Samira Patel <samira.patel@finorb.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposal: 3-month Dedicated pilot + SLA amendment for FinOrb renewal

Alex / Samira —

Thanks for taking the call last week. Per our discussion, here's the proposal we recommend to unblock your renewal and provide operational safety during the initial post-go-live window: 

What we propose
- 3-month Dedicated pilot with reserved capacity (baseline 8 A100-equivalent GPUs).
- SLA amendment during pilot: 99.95% monthly availability + p95 latency <120ms for standard generation calls (<=512 tokens).
- Credit schedule: tiered monthly credits as Rishi outlined (5%/10% bands) with a 30% cap.
- Short-term mitigation (immediate): 20% capacity buffer and aggressive prefix caching enabled for your hot routes.

Commercials
- Estimated incremental cost: ~$65k/month for the pilot (detailed breakdown attached).
- Pilot includes priority SRE on-call, extended telemetry retention, and a joint runbook.

Attachments
- Redwood-PremiumAmendment-v1.pdf (draft amendment + cost breakdown)

Next steps
1) Please review the attached amendment; let us know redlines by EOD Tue, Nov 24.
2) If you agree, we'll prepare a DocuSign envelope and schedule a kickoff within 5 business days of signature.
3) We will provision the reserved pool immediately upon signature and start a 72-hr stabilization window.

If you want any changes to the SLO targets or the pilot term, call me directly and we'll iterate. Our goal is to make the renewal a non-event for your product and SRE teams.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0187
[Attachment: Redwood-PremiumAmendment-v1.pdf (PDF)]
